question: Should the diagram viewer be reachable from other machines on your network, or only from this computer?
options: share on the local network (needs a token)
why: a shared viewer answers to anything on the network, so it requires a token; local-only has no login at all

question: Install the skill for every AI coding agent on this machine, or only for the ones you use?
options: every harness found on this machine
default: every harness found on this machine
why: the skill is one directory; installing it once in the shared agents directory serves most harnesses
